An overview of gate calls
This article is for visitors

Gate Calls for Companion Animal Travel

Gate calls help travelers coordinate the final steps before boarding when traveling with a pet. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk uses gate call updates to keep the process steady and clear for travelers, the cabin team, and the animal.

When a gate call is made, listen for the announcement and follow the directions from airport staff. If you are traveling with a cat or another approved companion animal, stay near the assigned gate area unless a staff member gives different guidance. Keep the carrier secured, closed, and ready for inspection. Pepper, like any other pet, should remain calm and inside the carrier unless you are asked to open it.

The cabin team monitors animals during flight and gives patient attention throughout the journey. Before boarding, they may review the animal's documents, confirm the carrier condition, and check that the traveler is prepared for boarding. <<FACT F079>> Bring the required papers with you and keep them easy to show, since missing documents can delay the process.

If the gate changes, move at once and keep your pet with you. Use the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help if you need direction, if your animal appears stressed, or if any item in your travel file needs review. Travelers should also make sure water, absorbent lining, and other approved comfort items are ready before the gate call.

For further assistance, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you leave for the airport or speak with the airport team at the gate.
